description: Hand-confirmed ball positions for the two local test clips. Coordinates only (no images). Pixel coordinates are in the 720x1280 converted .mp4; the iPhone .mov originals are the same picture at 3x (multiply by 3). Frame numbers start at 0 and refer to the container-timestamp order (first frame = F0). Event marks (events) are the owner's manual marks.

At 6x zoom on the 4K original the ball is separable (a cream-coloured blob). Camera rotation was not the cause (the background is static F94-F111); motion blur affects F97-F98; the pitcher's foot/glove enters from below from about F107 and sits next to the ball at F110-F111.
